{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA rows
qa_rows = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Found {len(qa_rows)} QA rows with revenue 999999.99")
print(qa_rows[['order_id', 'channel', 'revenue_clean']])

# Remove QA rows
df_clean = df[~(df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99)].copy()

# Verify removal
print(f"Remaining rows after removing QA: {len(df_clean)}")"}
